paragraphs.craft: I'm a <pixelPerfect>Systems engineer</pixelPerfect>, trying to make games feel, <pixelPerfect>fast, fluid and alive</pixelPerfect> to make unforgettable experiences.

highlights.engine-work: I worked on integrating and updating middleware software into the engine as well as upgrading Unreal Engine to new versions.
highlights.support-work: Created tooling to help wider teams adhere to memory budgets, improve UI workflow and capability alongside game side system functionality, and generate clarity on game performance through telemetry systems.
highlights.compliance-work: Enforced ruling on the codebase to increase code quality and conformance for future engine version upgrades to aid in new platform releases.
